name: scientific-architecture-diagrams
title_zh: 论文配图重建器：先读源码再画架构图
tagline_zh: 拿论文和代码，用 ImageGen 构图、Mermaid 重建，输出可编辑的科研架构图。不画装饰图。
tagline_en: Turn a paper + its code into grounded, editable architecture diagrams via ImageGen + Mermaid. No decorative.
desc_en: Rebuild research system or neural-network architecture diagrams from a paper and source code using grounded ImageGen composition plus editable Mermaid reconstruction; not for generic decorative illustrations or unsupported claims.
why_zh: 先锚定源码里的真实模块与连接，再让 ImageGen 只做视觉合成。
why_en: It grounds every box and edge in actual code, then lets ImageGen handle only the pixels while Mermaid keeps the topology editable.
limit_zh: 只认科研论文配图与神经网络架构图；需要你提供论文 PDF 和对应源码路径。不处理纯装饰性插图，也不为论文里没写。
limit_en: Only for research figures & NN architectures from a paper + its code. No decorative art. Won't invent structures absent from both sources.
title_en: Rebuild paper architecture diagrams from source code
